comment: Independent wintty.c tty_message_menu() witness: a Valkyrie names her dagger so that its inventory line no longer fits on one row, then asks for the throw list with ?. The one-item message menu wraps, so tty_putstr() raises its own --More--, which leaves the top line TOPLINE_EMPTY and records the answering key in morc. Escape there cancels the throw with "Never mind."; the variation answers the same --More-- with the item letter, which selects the dagger and reaches the direction prompt.
